headline_marked: Fuel prices remain unchanged for October after September hike
headline: Fuel prices remain unchanged for October after September hike
summary: Consumers will continue to pay Tk 135 per litre for diesel and Tk 165 for octane as the government decided to keep fuel prices unchanged for October.
details: After a significant increase in fuel prices in September, the government has announced that prices will remain unchanged for October. This decision means consumers will continue to pay Tk 135 per litre for diesel, Tk 165 for octane, Tk 160 for petrol, and Tk 155 for kerosene.

The previous price hike on September 20th saw all four fuel types increase by Tk 20 per litre. This followed a trend of rising international fuel prices, exacerbated by the conflict in West Asia, which had also prompted a price increase in April.

The Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation (BPC) reported significant losses, amounting to Tk 228.76 billion, from March to August. The September price increase is expected to help reduce these losses by approximately Tk 100 billion.

While Bangladesh operates under an automatic pricing system that adjusts fuel costs monthly based on international market rates, consistent adjustments have not been made recently. The government's decision to hold prices steady for October deviates from this automatic system.

headline: Retired Major General arrested over attack on Salman Muktadir's studio
summary: Retired Major General Golam Mohiuddin was arrested in connection with the attack on New Gini Properties and Salman Muktadir's studio.
details: Retired Major General Golam Mohiuddin was arrested by law enforcement agencies in connection with the attack on the studio of Salman Muktadir.
The arrest follows an investigation into the attack on New Gini Properties, where Salman Muktadir's studio was located.
Mohiuddin was listed as the fourth accused in the case filed regarding the incident.
The legal proceedings against the former high-ranking military officer are ongoing as the investigation continues.
caption:
A retired Major General has been arrested for his alleged involvement in an attack on a studio.

Retired Major General Golam Mohiuddin was arrested by law enforcement agencies in connection with the attack on the studio of Salman Muktadir.

The arrest follows an investigation into the attack on New Gini Properties, where Salman Muktadir's studio was located.

Mohiuddin was listed as the fourth accused in the case filed regarding the incident.

The legal proceedings against the former high-ranking military officer are ongoing as the investigation continues.
